value.summary: GreenLeaf Logistics wants a dispatcher web app and driver mobile app for managing and tracking deliveries, integrating with SAP Business One and a mapping provider, notifying customers, capturing proof of delivery, and reporting KPIs. A pilot is targeted in four months. Azure AD SSO and AI-based damage detection are tentative; payments are explicitly out of scope.

requirements.text: Provide a web application for dispatchers and a mobile application for drivers.
Allow drivers to log in using their work email.
Provide an admin back office where dispatchers can create, edit, list, and search jobs, drivers, and vehicles.
Provide a dispatcher dashboard showing today's jobs and a map of driver positions.
Integrate with SAP Business One to import orders every 15 minutes and send delivery status updates back to the ERP.
Integrate with a mapping provider to support routes and estimated arrival times.
Send customers SMS and email notifications when a driver is on the way.
Allow drivers to capture proof of delivery in the mobile app using a photo and signature.
Provide monthly management KPI reports for on-time delivery percentage and jobs per driver, with Excel export.
Migrate approximately 40,000 historical jobs from the existing Access database.
Support deletion of drivers' location data upon request to meet the stated GDPR need.
Target delivery of a pilot within four months.
Payments are not part of the application scope; invoicing remains in SAP.

ambiguities: Azure AD SSO is described as a possibility for later, not a confirmed pilot requirement.
Automatic damage detection is described as a nice-to-have, with no confirmed scope or acceptance criteria.
The mapping provider is not selected; Google Maps is only suggested.
The brief does not define what qualifies as a driver being 'on the way' or the notification trigger and content.
The required location update frequency, retention period, and exact deletion behavior are unspecified.
The brief does not define the pilot's feature set, user volumes, or acceptance criteria.
assumptions: The dispatcher web app and driver mobile app are both intended for the pilot unless the client prioritizes a reduced pilot scope.
Driver work-email login means standard application authentication; Azure AD SSO is excluded unless confirmed.
The SAP integration must support both order import and delivery-status updates, but detailed SAP interfaces and credentials will be provided by the client.
The 40,000 historical jobs are available in an extractable form from Access, and migration includes only the data needed by the agreed application scope.
Excel export means a downloadable spreadsheet of the specified monthly KPIs.
risks: The four-month pilot target may be at risk due to the breadth of web, mobile, ERP, mapping, messaging, reporting, and migration work.
SAP Business One integration complexity depends on the client's version, configuration, available APIs, and data quality.
Third-party mapping and SMS/email services may introduce licensing costs, usage limits, or setup dependencies.
Historical Access data may be inconsistent or require substantial cleansing and mapping.
Handling driver location, photos, and signatures creates privacy, security, retention, and access-control obligations beyond the stated deletion need.
AI damage detection could materially increase effort and require labeled training data, model evaluation, and operational monitoring.
out_of_scope: Invoicing functionality in the new application; invoicing remains in SAP.

unknowns.question: Should Azure AD SSO be included in the pilot?
unknowns.why_it_matters: SSO adds identity-provider configuration, authentication flows, testing, and coordination with GreenLeaf IT beyond basic work-email login.

scenario_if_yes.title: Configure Azure AD SSO and implement application sign-in integration
Coordinate identity setup and validate SSO behavior

unknowns.question: Should automatic AI damage detection be included in the pilot?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Image-based damage detection may require data preparation, model selection or training, integration into the photo workflow, and accuracy evaluation; this is substantially more work than capturing photos alone.

scenario_if_yes.title: Assess image data and prepare damage-detection dataset
Integrate damage detection into proof-of-delivery workflow

unknowns.question: Is Google Maps the required mapping provider, and does GreenLeaf already have an account and API credentials?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Provider choice affects implementation, licensing, API setup, and route/ETA behavior; missing credentials or a different provider can change integration effort.

scenario_if_yes.title: Set up Google Maps APIs, credentials, and provider-specific integration

unknowns.question: Does the pilot require production-grade SAP Business One integration using a specific API or middleware, rather than a simpler agreed import/export mechanism?
unknowns.why_it_matters: The SAP interface, deployment environment, authentication, error handling, and data mapping can significantly change integration and testing effort.

scenario_if_yes.title: Implement and validate production SAP Business One integration
Configure integration environment and deployment connectivity
Test SAP integration flows and failure handling

unknowns.question: Must the historical migration include data cleansing, deduplication, and reconciliation beyond loading the available Access records?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Data quality remediation and reconciliation can add substantial analysis, transformation, and validation work beyond a straightforward migration.

scenario_if_yes.title: Profile, cleanse, and reconcile historical job data
Validate migrated records and reconciliation results

unknowns.question: Does GDPR compliance require additional controls such as configurable retention, audit trails, or deletion across backups and derived records, beyond deleting location data on request?
unknowns.why_it_matters: The stated deletion need may require broader privacy workflows and technical controls depending on the client's interpretation and compliance obligations.

scenario_if_yes.title: Define and implement privacy retention, audit, and deletion controls
Review privacy controls and verify deletion behavior
